assertions.assertion: Explains that by default unmatched requests (and requests with the /t prefix but no match) return 404
assertions.rationale: Says 404 is correct but does not explain the default behaviour for unmatched requests or the /t prefix case.

assertions.assertion: Warns FallbackToDefault should only be enabled when serving unmatched host/path from the default space is an intentional part of the isolation model
assertions.rationale: Says only use fallback if the default space is intentionally a public/single-tenant-compatible space.

assertions.assertion: States a strict 404 is safer for multi-tenant deployments
assertions.rationale: Recommends keeping FallbackToDefault=false and 404 as the safe behaviour.

assertions.assertion: Mentions the default space uses data pool 0
